verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting product offers customizable heatmaps for spotting spikes or dips in "key metrics" and conversational Ask AI analysis of customer conversations, so a reporting dashboard exists. However, the evidence never names the specific KPIs in the story. Missing for 10: explicit resolution-rate, CSAT, handoff/escalation-rate and cost-per-resolution metrics, exec-ready dashboard or export documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
